chapter: Later Blue Note years and ending the habit
title: How his habit ended in 1965
summary: After six months in jail, served four and a half, and help from a doctor who held him together with Dollie, he stopped; he was tired of jail.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: When did the monkey end? When did the monster end?
’65. And what brought it to an end?

I went to jail and stayed in jail for a six-month period. I got out in four months and 15 days on good behavior. Came home. Then I had a doctor that had been writing me letters and that wanted to see me. I went to see her. She was very helpful in getting me – keeping me together, holding me together with Dollie. That’s how it happened.
Was it sort of the end of the road kind of scenario? Were you . . . ?
I was just tired of going to jail. I went to jail three times, for nothing, over really . . .
Yeah, a nothing. $10 worth or something. It’s terrible, man. So I just – it was time to stop.
